title: CHAPTER 1:UNDERSTANDING INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS
content: 👋 እንኳን ወደ ክፍለ ትምህርት 1.7 በሰላም መጣችሁ! በዚህ ትምህርት የዓለም አቀፍ ግንኙነትን በጥልቀት ለመረዳት የሚያስችሉንን ዋና ዋና የትምህርት ዘርፍ ቲዮሪዎችን (IR Theories) — Idealism/Liberalism, Realism, Structuralism/Marxism, Constructivism እና Critical Theories—በዝርዝር እናያለን። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 1.7. Introduction to IR Theories 🔹 The Need for Theoretical Lenses - Global interactions (wars, poverty, trade, human rights) directly affect all nations and individuals. - Theories function as analytical lenses: they allow us to simplify, interpret, and make sense of complex international events. - 👉 ቲዮሪዎች የዓለም አቀፍ ፖለቲካን ሁነቶች በግልጽ እንድንረዳና እንድናነፃፅር የሚረዱን የትንታኔ መነፅሮች (Analytical Lenses) ናቸው። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 1.7.1. Idealism / Liberalism 🔹 Core Assumptions - Human nature is innately good; peace and international cooperation are achievable and desirable. - Immanuel Kant (18th Century): Posited that liberal/democratic states sharing common values do not go to war with each other. - Democratic Peace Theory: Modern continuation of Kant's idea, asserting that democracies do not engage in war against each other. - 👉 ሊበራሊዝም በሰው ልጅ በጎ ተፈጥሮ የሚያምን ሲሆን፣ በዲሞክራሲያዊ ሀገራት መካከል ሰላም እና ትብብር እንደሚሰፍን ያስተምራል። 🔹 Historical Development & Foundations - Woodrow Wilson’s 14 Points (1918): Proposed creating an association of nations, leading to the establishment of the League of Nations (1920) to preserve peace. - Scott Burchill: Identified three liberal preferences: democracy over aristocracy, free trade over autarky, and collective security over balance-of-power systems. - Failure of League of Nations (1939): The outbreak of WWII exposed the limitations of utopian idealism. - 👉 የሊግ ኦፍ ኔሽንስ መመስረት የሊበራሊዝም ትልቅ ውጤት የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በ1939 የሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ሲቀሰቀስ ፈራረሰ። 🔹 International Law & Functions - International law facilitates state cooperation through two distinct systems: 1. Operating System: Rules setting out distribution of authority, rights, and mechanisms for cross-border interactions. 2. Normative System: Framework shaping values and goals (e.g., International Human Rights Law). - 👉 ዓለም አቀፍ ሕግ በሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት የሚያስተካክል (Operating System) እና እሴቶችን የሚያስጠብቅ (Normative System) መዋቅር ነው። 💡 Exam Hint: የ Immanuel Kant 'Democratic Peace Theory' እና የ Woodrow Wilson '14 Points' ለፈተና በብዛት የሚጠየቁ ናቸው! ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 1.7.2. Realism 🔹 Core Assumptions & Human Nature - Rejects liberal optimism as "utopianism." Views human nature as self-interested and selfish. - Conflict is inevitable; war is common because the international system lacks a central governing authority (Anarchy). - E.H. Carr (1939 - The Twenty Years' Crisis): Introduced the distinction between 'what is' (fact) and 'what ought to be' (value). - 👉 ሪአሊዝም በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ አናርኪ በመኖሩ ምክንያት ግጭትና ጦርነት አይቀሬ ነው ብሎ የሚያምን አመለካከት ነው።አናርኪን ቀደም ብለን ስላዬን ግልፅ ይመስለኛል ማብራራት አይጠበቅብኝም። 🔹 Key Thinkers & Concepts - Classical Roots: Thucydides (Peloponnesian War), Machiavelli, and Thomas Hobbes (State of Nature / "war of all against all"). - Hans Morgenthau (1948 - Politics Among Nations): Stated that "all politics is a struggle for power" and defined national interest strictly in terms of power. - Hedley Bull (1977 - The Anarchical Society): Associated with the English School, emphasizing normative codes of conduct and international society. - Kenneth Waltz (1959/1979): Founded Neorealism / Structural Realism, focusing on how the structure of the anarchic international system dictates state behavior. - 👉 ሀንስ ሞርገንታው "ፖለቲካ የኃይል ሽሚያ ነው" ሲል፣ ኬኔት ዎልትዝ ደግሞ የዓለም አቀፍ ስርዓቱ መዋቅር ሀገራትን ለኃይል ሽሚያ እንደሚያስገድዳቸው ይገልጻሉ። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 1.7.3. Structuralism / Marxism 🔹 Core Theoretical Framework - Based on Karl Marx's analysis: Capitalism divides society into the bourgeoisie (capitalists) and the proletariat (workers). - Global Centre-Periphery Structure: Extends class conflict to the international level, creating unequal exchange between the wealthy 'North' (Centre) and poor 'South' (Periphery). - Dependency Theory (Andre Gunder Frank & Samir Amin): Argues that developing nations are kept in poverty to enrich developed nations. - World Systems Analysis (Immanuel Wallerstein): Traces the historical expansion of global capitalism since the 16th century. - 👉 ማርክሲዝም በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ያለውን ሀብታም (North/Centre) እና ድሃ (South/Periphery) ሀገራት የኢኮኖሚ ብዝበዛና አለመመጣጠን ያጎላል። ነጭ ነጯን ማለት ይሄ ነው፣ ግን ምን ያደርጋል የዓለም ምርጫዋ ከእውነት ይልቅ ማስመሰል ሁኗል። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 1.7.4. Constructivism 🔹 Core Ideas & Social Norms - Positions itself as a middle ground between mainstream and critical theories. - Focuses on shared values, identities, and social interaction on the global stage. - Alexander Wendt (1992): Famously declared that "Anarchy is what states make of it." - Asserts that international reality is socially constructed by human ideas and evolving norms rather than fixed power capabilities. - 👉 ኮንስትራክቲቪዝም እንደ አሌክሳንደር ዌንት አባባል "አናርኪ ሀገራት የሰጡት ትርጉም ነው" ይላል፤ የዓለም ፖለቲካ በሀገራት ሀሳብና ልማድ (Norms) የሚቀያየር ነው። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 1.7.5. Critical Theories & Post-colonialism 🔹 Critical Approaches Overview - Rejects mainstream assumptions (Realism/Liberalism) and gives a voice to marginalized populations, women, and the Global South. - Marxist Critical Theory: Questions the legitimacy of the state, advocating for human emancipation from state-led capitalism. 🔹 Post-colonialism - Examines ongoing inequalities created by European imperialism and colonization. - Edward Said (1978 - Orientalism): Criticized Western-centric depictions of the Middle East and Asia. - Demands the inclusion of voices from the Global South in international policy. - 👉 ፖስት-ኮሎኒያሊዝም በምዕራባውያን የበላይነት የተፃፈውን የ IR እይታ በመቃወም የደቡብ አህጉራት (Global South) ድምፅ እንዲሰማ ይታገላል። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Comparing Theoretical Lenses: The Case of the United Nations (UN) - Realism: The UN only works when serving powerful states' self-interests (e.g., the US invading Iraq in 2003 without UN authorization). - Liberalism: The UN is essential for fostering cooperation, international law, and maintaining global order. - Constructivism: Disregarding the UN violates international norms and carries long-term diplomatic consequences. - Marxism: The UN legitimizes global capitalism and protects the interest of elite classes. - Post-colonialism: The UN Security Council lacks permanent African or Latin American members, perpetuating colonial privilege. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 👋እንኳን ደስ አላችሁ! የምዕራፍ 1 ትምህርታችንን በሙሉ ስኬት አጠናቀናል። ይህንን ዝርዝር ማስታወሻ በጥንቃቄ በማንበብ ለፈተናችሁ ብቁ ሁኑ። በቀጣዩ ምዕራፍ እስከምንገናኝ መልካም የጥናት ጊዜ ይሁንላችሁ! 🙏🙏🙏
